# Baserow

Baserow is an open-source database tool that lets teams build no-code data applications, collaborate on records, and integrate with other services for data management

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/baserow/.

## Actions

- **List Databases** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all databases in a specified workspace.
- **List Tables in Database** (read-only): This tool lists all tables within a specified baserow database.
